requirements.requirement: The system must map 'Phase I' to a normalized numeric score lower than 'Phase II', 'Phase III', and 'Phase IV'.
The system must map 'Phase II' to a normalized numeric score higher than 'Phase I' and lower than 'Phase III' and 'Phase IV'.
The system must map 'Phase III' to a normalized numeric score higher than 'Phase II' and lower than 'Phase IV'.
The system must map 'Phase IV' to the highest normalized numeric score among all supported phase values.
The system must assign a deterministic numeric score for each valid phase input such that repeated calls with the same phase return the same score.
The system must normalize all valid phase scores to a consistent numeric scale (e.g., bounded range) as defined by the schema.
The system must correctly handle combined phase values (e.g., 'Phase I/II') by assigning a score between the two corresponding phase scores or using a predefined mapping.
The system must treat phase input values case-insensitively (e.g., 'phase iii' equals 'Phase III').
The system must return a default score for 'N/A' or missing phase values that is lower than 'Phase I'.
The system must not throw an exception when the phase field is null or absent and must instead return the default score.
The system must handle unexpected or unsupported phase strings by assigning the default score without failing.
The system must implement the phase-to-score mapping as a pure function with no external API calls or side effects.
